title: The Five Forms of the Self and the Twelve Judges
description: The watchmen who now wound. T27 anatomizes the self's five-formed body — head as ravenous love, wings as thoughts mounting upward, feet as lower cravings, belly as dark substrate, loins as sense-knowledges in waters — one self-loving formation showing five aspects, hard against any cutting, oscillating between fire and cold. T28 — the twelve registers of the Lord's discrimination, sent forth from the inmost where divine love is hidden, each a different depth of the rational at which the Lord judges what is his and what is claimed. T29 — the eight thrones outside and the corresponding nine thrones within the cosmos at which the Lord is recognized as ruling. The same doctrinal truths that guided in State 2 now strike at this deeper depth.
